title: Industrialized AEC Platform Development
objective: Accelerate AIAS through a governed development factory and parallel capability megablocks without sacrificing semantic ownership, normative responsibility, traceability or professional safety.
principles: AIAS retains semantic kernel, project graph, orchestration, standards, intelligence and UX ownership.
Specialized external technologies are adapters or workers, never uncontrolled replacements for AIAS governance.
The deterministic kernel calculates and validates; AI plans and orchestrates.
Every megablock requires SDD, Constitution traceability, tests, documentation, installer, release evidence, Dashboard and ACE updates.
No normative compliance, license, certification or professional approval is inferred without external evidence.
